purpose: A page whose job is one form, such as checkout or account details: titled sections of fields, then the actions, with an optional summary beside the form.

props.name: variant
props.description: single-column (default), or with-summary for a summary panel beside the form

props.name: backLink
props.description: A link back, above the title

props.name: children
props.description: The form, one Section per group of fields

props.name: summary
props.description: with-summary only: a summary such as the order total

props.name: actions
props.description: The submit button, with any cancel or back action

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called on submit; the page does not reload

whenToUse: Checkout, account details, applications and any page that exists to complete one form
with-summary when people need to see what they are agreeing to, such as an order total
antiPatterns: More than six fields with no sections
A total people only see after the submit button

sizes: Container md or lg; summary column at least `size-grid-item-md`; gaps `space-layout-section`, `space-component-padding-lg`

a11yNotes: One main landmark; the form is named by the h1
The summary comes before the form in source order, so people reach the total before the fields and the submit button

slots.name: title
slots.description: What the form achieves. Example: Checkout. Up to about 40 characters.

slots.name: description
slots.description: One sentence on what happens when they finish. Up to 140 characters.

slots.name: sections
slots.description: One Section per group of related fields, each titled. Example: Shipping address, Payment.

slots.name: summary
slots.description: with-summary only. What is being bought or submitted, with the total last. Shown beside the form, or above it on narrow screens.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: One contained submit button that says what happens, last. Example: Place order. Optional text button to cancel.
